claim: Lerwick Up Helly Aa 2026 falls on Tuesday 27 January 2026, the last Tuesday of January, with the torchlit procession of nearly a thousand guizers led by the Jarl Squad lighting torches at 19:30 before burning the Viking galley.
quote: At 18:50, the participants, known as Guizers... will gather to receive their torches. On the stroke of 19:30, a rocket fired into the sky is the signal for them to light up their torches

claim: Up Helly Aa 2026 in Lerwick centres on a single evening procession and galley burning on 27 January 2026, a fire festival rooted in Viking folklore.
quote: Up Helly Aa 2026 – fire, folklore and a night to remember

claim: Las Fallas Valencia 2026 climaxes with La Cremà on Thursday 19 March 2026 (Día de San José), when nearly 800 monuments are burned across the city.
La Cremà 2026 burns in staged sequence on 19 March: infantiles from 20:00, large fallas from 22:00, the Special Section winner at 22:30, and the Plaza del Ayuntamiento falla last at 23:00.
quote: A partir de las 20:00 horas tendrá lugar la cremá de las fallas infantiles. Las fallas grandes arderán a partir de las 22:00 horas y a las 22:30 se quemará la falla que haya obtenido el primer premio de la Sección Especial y a las 23:00 horas será la Cremá de la falla de la plaza del Ayuntamiento

claim: Nuit Blanche Paris 2026, the 25th edition, runs the night of Saturday 6 June into Sunday 7 June 2026 from 18:00 to 05:00, a free all-night contemporary art event under artistic director Barbara Butch themed on Love with nearly 200 installations.
Nuit Blanche 2026 is a free all-night festival across Paris and Ile-de-France, opening venues usually closed to the public for one night.
quote: Nuit Blanche 2026: free all-night art festival guide

claim: Edinburgh's Hogmanay Street Party on Princes Street admits 45,000 ticketed revellers for the 31 December midnight countdown; the wider festival runs 29 December to 1 January with a Torchlight Procession opener.
quote: Edinburgh's Hogmanay Street Party will welcome 45,000 revellers into Princes Street

claim: Sydney New Year's Eve fireworks launch at midnight on 31 December from the Harbour Bridge, Opera House and city rooftops; the 2025/26 show ran 12 minutes over 7km with 25,000 pyrotechnic shots and a bridge waterfall effect.
Barcelona's La Mercè 2026 runs 23-27 September with Manchester as guest city, closing with the Piromusical fireworks-and-music spectacular at the Font Magica de Montjuic.
quote: La Mercè 2026 is confirmed from 23 to 27 September, with Manchester as the guest city

claim: Reykjavik New Year's Eve features 10+ community bonfires (aramotabrenna) lit around 20:30, with no official municipal fireworks display - residents launch their own at midnight in a 360-degree, 30-45 minute self-organised spectacle.

Madrid's Nochevieja at Puerta del Sol on 31 December has crowds eat 12 lucky grapes to the 12 midnight chimes; capacity is limited to roughly 15,000 and a 30 December rehearsal (Preuvas) draws crowds too.
quote: New Year's Eve at Puerta del Sol
